_comment: A bump held back on purpose. A hold reads HELD only while the pin is still at `current` AND upstream's newest release is still `latest_reviewed`; anything newer re-raises BEHIND. Drop the row when the bump lands. eco "upstream" holds a scripts/upstreams.json tag_release row by its name. An optional `release` field names the condition that lifts the hold as a token, not prose (e.g. "vm-proof"), so a resolver can read it.
